# Security review — payment

> Generated by `sdem security document` (sdem-security 0.1.2) from the workspace and its security standard. Read-only: it shows what the design holds and what SDEM's security rules find — nothing added, nothing decided. Controls are NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5; threats are STRIDE.

## Summary

62 records in scope across A1–A4; 22 protected by a control of their own. 15 controls, 9 threats, 1 trust boundary. 1 finding(s) not compliant, 6 unresolved.

| Security layer | Records | Protected | Controls | Threats |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 Business security | 12 | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| S2 Service domain security | 6 | 6 | 6 | 4 |
| S3 Data security | 4 | 3 | 1 | 2 |
| S4 Application security | 14 | 5 | 4 | 1 |
| S5 Technology security | 26 | 5 | 3 | 2 |

### SEC-S03b — a communication path names its protocol (SC-8, PR.DS)

- **unresolved** — Application to database path (PATH-DATA)
